facts.heading: Divorce from Radka
facts.content: Jana and Radka decided to divorce after 15 years of marriage. Jana still cannot understand the decision.
facts.evidence: After 15 years of marriage, Radka and I decided to divorce. And I still can't understand it.

facts.heading: Divorce happened in September
facts.content: Radka told Jana in September that it was not possible anymore.
facts.evidence: And in September he told me that it's not possible anymore.

facts.heading: Jana's emotional state
facts.content: Jana experienced feelings of emptiness, anger, and emptiness 30 times a day.
facts.evidence: Empty. Then anger. Then again emptiness. 30 times a day.

facts.heading: Regret about past actions
facts.content: Jana thinks she should have seen things and feels blind. She keeps looking back where she made a mistake.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I'm blind. I keep looking back in my head where I made a mistake.

facts.heading: Feelings regarding past roles
facts.content: Jana thinks she might have been too tired or too worried about her relationship.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I think I was too tired and I didn't care about her. Sometimes I thought I was too much worried.

facts.heading: Children's living situation
facts.content: Jana has two children, Anička aged 12 and Matěj aged 8. The children will stay with Jana.
facts.evidence: I have two kids. Anička is 12 and Matěj is 8 years old. The children will stay with me.

facts.heading: Anička's concern about father
facts.content: Anička asked Jana if they were arguing with Dad last week.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if we were arguing with dad.

facts.heading: Jana lied to Anička
facts.content: Jana lied to Anička about arguing with Dad, and Anička knew it.
facts.evidence: I lied to her. And she knew it.

facts.heading: Jana's fear of telling truth
facts.content: Jana is afraid of the children's tears when telling them the truth.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid of their tears.

facts.heading: Jana's career occupation
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.

facts.heading: Jana's teaching level
facts.content: Jana teaches 9th and 8th graders.
facts.evidence: I teach 9th and 8th graders.

facts.heading: Struggles with studying
facts.content: Jana goes to class with a crutch in her neck. Jana feels like everyone sees her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I go to class with a crutch in my neck. I feel like everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Teacher offered support
facts.content: Jana told the teacher about crying at the walk. The teacher let Jana leave earlier and gave her a free hour.
facts.evidence: I told her that because I once cried at the walk. She let me leave earlier, gave me a free hour

facts.heading: Work situation causes distress
facts.content: Jana felt worse after the teacher let her leave. She was alone at work and had to do something.
facts.evidence: but then I was sitting at home and it was worse. Because I was alone at work, I had to do something.

facts.heading: Sleep disturbances at night
facts.content: Jana wakes up at 3 a.m. every night and thinks about what is next.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at 3 a.m. and think about what's next.

facts.heading: Thoughts about future uncertainty
facts.content: When waking up, Jana thinks about not having a mortgage, a husband, or anything. She counts money and imagines telling her children.
facts.evidence: I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a husband, I don't have anything. I count the money and imagine how I will tell my children.

facts.heading: Sleep schedule shift
facts.content: Jana sleeps around 5 a.m. and gets up at 7.30 a.m. She is already tired in the morning.
facts.evidence: I sleep around 5 am and get up at 7.30 am. I'm tired already in the morning.

facts.heading: Weight loss and appearance
facts.content: Jana does not eat much and has lost 4 kilos. A friend tells her she looks terrible.
facts.evidence: I don't eat much. I lost 4 kilos. My friend tells me that I look terrible.

facts.heading: Support system contacts
facts.content: Jana has a sister in Olomouc who calls almost every evening. She also has a friend named Eva from work.
facts.evidence: I have a sister in Olomouc, she calls me almost every evening and my friend Eva from work.

facts.heading: Friend Eva's behavior
facts.content: Eva wants almost everything and wants Jana to have a hard time. Eva does not want Jana to think about anything.
facts.evidence: She wants almost everything. Eva just wants me to have a hard time. She doesn't want me to think about anything.

facts.heading: Fear of lying
facts.content: Jana is afraid that she lied. She is afraid that a woman who cannot keep a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That I lied. That a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Origin of belief about marriage
facts.content: The thought about marriage comes from her mother. Her mother always said marriage is a thing and that it is what it is.
facts.evidence: Probably from my mum. She always said that marriage is a thing and that it's what it is.

facts.heading: Mother's reaction to introduction
facts.content: When Jana introduced her mother, her mother was silent. Then she said she hopes Jana has been good to her.
facts.evidence: She was silent. Then she said that she hopes I've been good to her.

facts.heading: Mother's contact frequency
facts.content: The mother has not called Jana much since that interaction.
facts.evidence: She hasn't called me much since then.

facts.heading: Jana's current feeling
facts.content: Jana feels sad. She wants someone to forgive her.
facts.evidence: Sad. I need you to forgive me.

facts.heading: Jana's desire to express feelings
facts.content: Jana wants to say that it hurts and that she does not want to be alone, but that it does not happen there.
facts.evidence: That it hurts, that I don't want to be alone, but that it doesn't happen here.

facts.heading: Reaction to speaking out loud
facts.content: When Jana says these things out loud, she cries and apologizes. Jana states it is nothing.
facts.evidence: I cry and I apologize. It's nothing.

facts.heading: Seeking help for sleep
facts.content: Jana has tried cucumber tea for sleep. The doctor offered her some powder, but she does not want it.
facts.evidence: Cucumber tea and that's all. Doctor offered me some powder, but I don't want to.

facts.heading: Fear of dependency
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will not be able to wake up for her children in time and does not want to be dependent.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I wouldn't be able to wake up for my children in time and I don't want to be dependent.

facts.heading: Wakes Jana up
facts.content: Jana was asked to write down what wakes her up.
facts.evidence: write down what wakes you up?

facts.heading: Fear of panicking
facts.content: Jana is afraid of panicking and crying. She is afraid of not being able to stay calm.
facts.evidence: That I'll panic and cry. That I won't be able to stay calm.

facts.heading: Concern about children
facts.content: Jana is concerned about how children might react to her sadness.
facts.evidence: That it would be scary for them?

facts.heading: Ančka is sensitive
facts.content: Ančka is sensitive. This was mentioned as a potential factor.
facts.evidence: Ančka is sensitive.

facts.heading: Goal for today
facts.content: Jana's goal for the day was to feel not alone and not have to manage things right away.
facts.evidence: That I'm not alone and I don't have to manage it right away.
